Sobre a vaga

We’re looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer with strong expertise in .NET MAUI and cross-platform mobile development. This role requires deep knowledge of the mobile development lifecycle and best practices, along with the ability to provide technical leadership and strategic guidance. You’ll be working in partnership with a technology company focused on improving operations and user experience within the youth sports space, helping evolve the mobile stack while ensuring high-quality, scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead cross-platform mobile development initiatives using .NET MAUI.
  • Apply deep knowledge of the mobile development lifecycle and industry best practices.
  • Provide senior-level technical leadership to assess, improve, and establish engineering standards.
  • Evaluate the current technology stack and recommend modernization strategies where appropriate.
  • Ensure cost-effective solutions while maintaining high technical quality.
  • Support product and engineering initiatives aligned with growth in the youth sports technology space.

Core Requirements

  • Strong experience with .NET MAUI and cross-platform mobile development.
  • Deep understanding of the mobile development lifecycle, including architecture, testing, and deployment.
  • Proven experience in a senior or lead engineering role.
  • Experience evaluating and improving existing technology stacks.
  • Strong understanding of engineering best practices and scalable mobile architectures.
  • Ability to balance technical quality and cost-effectiveness.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work across teams.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience working in consumer-facing or sports-related platforms.
  • Background in modernizing legacy mobile applications.
  • Experience influencing technical strategy or product direction.

Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community, fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career - we’re the destination.

The icing on the Kake:

💵 Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.

🏡 Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.

🌱 Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.

❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

Life is Better with Kake! Kake offers premier teams of software engineers to support some of the world's most prominent and innovative brands. Whatever layer of development support you need, we’ve got you covered. Kake is a remote-first company with a community spanning the globe, fully believing that - it’s not where your table is but what you bring to the table that matters. Our approach and feedback have proven that we are not simply a stop along the way in an engineer’s career but the destination. We are proud to have fostered an environment that supports and retains high-caliber engineers & team members through our defined culture, initiatives, and investment in each individual. We truly believe that sharing our core values of growth, collaboration, and social impact is just as important as technical ability and acumen. Our community is comprised of individuals who have made substantial contributions in their fields of expertise, while also showcasing the characteristics of a strong teammate and an ideal culture fit. The real icing on the Kake and what sets us apart is our core belief that lifting others up is one of the most important and rewarding things we can do. Through initiatives like Compassion is Badass (supporting boots-on-the-ground social impact causes in our local communities) and our Better Me fund (an annual stipend to use to better oneself both personally and professionally), Kake aspires to inspire. Kake’s approach: Our Team is Your Team. Kake team members are ready to integrate seamlessly into yours and accelerate any project. We are 100% dedicated and committed to our partners’ long-term success and ready to support their needs to quickly scale in a broad spectrum of backgrounds and skill sets. Kake is ideally positioned to actively shape how companies can foster their business growth in the digital age and provide valuable support to ensure they do so effectively with the right team.
